description: This file defines core abstraction classes and functions for the Kivy framework, including provider loading, library selection, and error handling related to core components.

classes.name: CoreCriticalException
classes.description: Custom exception class for critical core errors.

methods.name: _is_strict_mode
methods.description: Checks if provider strict mode is enabled via environment variable.

methods.name: load_with_provider_selection
methods.description: Handles resource loading with provider selection, validation, and fallback.

methods.name: core_select_lib
methods.description: Selects and imports a core library provider based on configuration and availability.

methods.name: core_register_libs
methods.description: Registers available core library providers based on configuration.

methods.name: handle_win_lib_import_error
methods.description: Provides troubleshooting assistance for Windows DLL load errors related to Kivy providers.
